options.notes: This is a play. Rooms are the island's places (the ship can be the wreck on the shore), plus Prospero's cell and the yellow sands. Characters: Prospero, Ariel, Caliban and one more of your choice; single-word names. Make it an enacted play: besides the on-enter greetings, give each room one script with a cron trigger (spread over the hour, e.g. at minutes 0, 15, 30, 45) in which two characters present in that room exchange 3 to 5 short lines taken from the text; use schedule moves so the pairs are in the same room when the scene runs. Ariel wanders a lot, Caliban little. Sound: the shore rooms have wind, the cell has drips.
